work_item: B08 continuation: unique literal edit-location proposal through the ordinary CLI
subject: MINIDORA language, meaning, judgment, execution and memory engine
purpose: Resolve one caller-supplied literal in a replay-verified text artifact and emit a source-linked edit proposal; a separate explicit editor request applies it.
owner_instruction_scope: User continuation of the existing Rust implementation/QC/commit/push delegation. The two existing backup refs were rotated once at batch start.
version_boundary: Adds LocateTextReplacement to the existing Intent schema and one source-linked proposal artifact. The parser version advances to v40; no dependency, persistence schema, lockfile or prior artifact format changes. Existing composed/imported/edited text artifacts remain the only text-document bases. The proposal operation itself is not accepted as an editable text base.

environment.network: Unrestricted, enforced; no credentials or outbound identities used

backup_ref_observation: Remote has the two existing backup tags and no backup branch refs. An initial atomic push also naming absent remote branches was rejected without changing remote refs; the existing tags were then rotated with exact leases. No new ref was created.

legacy_source_lineage.inspected_contract: Atomic exact-original edits preserve protected spans and history; 編集箇所を特定 returns a proposal only when a literal search is unique.
Explicit input text, protected ranges, composition source mappings and digests.
Connects typed create/import/edit/location adapters; does not infer corrections from free text.

inheritance_boundary: The Rust implementation locates half-open UTF-8 byte offsets; the predecessor uses character offsets and embeds history. Rust replays immutable case-scoped artifacts. This is a bounded operation-level correspondence, not full legacy compatibility or full B08 acceptance. Frozen Python source/tests were not modified or run.
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of compact JSON inventory in code-snapshot.json.
actual_routes: Ordinary CLI/Engine -> input::seal/structured_intent -> Intent::LocateTextReplacement -> Core actor/case-scoped Store::get_bytes -> Replay verifies actual artifact bytes and regenerates supported text document ancestry -> locate_explicit_replacement finds one unique exact literal -> LocatedTextEdit artifact -> Core dependency/content/render/history.

The caller may separately submit the proposal object to ordinary text-edit input -> existing edit_explicit_text replays the base and rechecks digest, exact original text, protection, overlap and resource limits -> EditedText artifact -> Core content/render/history.
route_contract: Headers are 文章の置換箇所を特定して: and its fullwidth-colon form, plus ASCII-case-insensitive text-locate-replacement:. A newline is required; the complete JSON body is preserved.

Exact schema: {base_artifact, expected_text_sha256, search, replacement, id, reason}. Unknown fields, duplicate JSON keys, invalid digests, empty searches, no-op replacements, unsupported controls and invalid reason/ID limits stop.
The base is loaded only through the frontend-bound actor and current case. Its hash and entire canonical composition/import/edit ancestry are verified before searching.
Search is literal, case-sensitive and not normalized. Exactly one match is required. Repeated and overlapping matches are ambiguous; a missing match and any protected overlap suspend.

The proposal records the actual base artifact and text hashes, consumed ancestors, half-open UTF-8 byte range, matched text, search/replacement JSON token spans and a complete atomic text-edit request. It does not alter the document. The existing editor independently rechecks the proposal when explicitly submitted.

The Core stores the proposal artifact, carries its consumed artifact hashes into dependencies, renders the canonical report and checks the caller evidence budget. The location capability itself does not apply a document edit or initiate a provider action. Any explicitly requested local file output remains governed by the existing exact-target permission and receipt path.

resource_envelope.artifact_document: <=256000 UTF-8 bytes; imported max_chars <=100000 Unicode scalar values
resource_envelope.search_and_replacement: <=100000 Unicode scalar values each; search must be nonempty
resource_envelope.history: <=16 editing revisions; <=8000000 aggregate bytes; <=2000000 bytes per artifact
resource_envelope.deadline: Polled before/after ancestry replay and around the search operation; no in-progress cancellation polling.
resource_envelope.output: proposal artifact is limited by the existing artifact and request evidence budgets; the existing editor rechecks inherited output limits when applied.
